questions.question:
Following are the conditions for selecting a Deputy personnel Manager in an organization.

The candidate must –

(i) be a graduate in any discipline with at least 55% marks.

(ii) be at least 30 years and not more than 35 years as on 01-02-2017.

(iii) be ready to pay Rs 40,000 as security deposit.

(iv) have work experience of at least 3 years.

(v) cleared written examination with at least 50% marks

(vi) cleared personal interview with at least 40% marks In the case of candidate who fulfills all conditions except –

(a) at (i) above, but has secured at least 55% marks in post graduate in Management with specialization in Economic/Statistics, the case is to be referred as GM-Personnel.

(b) at (iii) above, but is ready to sign a bond of 1 year, the case is to be referred as SVP-Personnel. In each question below, details of a candidate are provided followed by a question and 5 courses of action. Select the course of action that applies to the person’s candidature.

 

Avantika was born on 04.11.1986. She has secured 70% marks in graduation. She has secured 50% marks in both the selection examination and personal interview. She has 5 years of work experience. She can pay a maximum of Rs 30,000 as a security deposit. Additionally, she is ready to sign a bond of 1 year.
options: if the candidate is to be selected
if the candidate is not to be selected
if the case is to be referred to as GM-Personnel.
if the case is to be referred to as SVP-Personnel.
if the data provided are inadequate to take a decision.
questions.explanation: She fulfills all criteria, except that she can pay only 30,000, so this leads – not to her selection. But since she can sign a bond of 1 year, so her case will be referred to as SVP-Personnel.

In each of the following questions, two statements numbered I and II are given. There may be a cause and effect relationship between the two statements. These two statements may be the effect of the same cause or independent causes. These statements may be independent causes without having any relationship. Read both the statements in each question and mark your answer :-

Statements:

  1. All the schools in the region had to be kept closed for most sections of the week.

  2. Many parents have excluded their children from the local schools.
options: Statement I is the cause and statement II is its effect
Statement II is the cause and statement I is its effect
Both the statements I and II are independent causes
Both the statements I and II are effects of independent causes
Both the statements I and II are effects of some common cause
questions.explanation:
Closing the schools for a week and the parents excluding their wards from the local schools are independent issues, which must have been triggered by different individual causes.

So, Both the statements I and II are effects of independent causes.

Hence, the correct answer is option D.

Statement: Should mountainous states along international borders be given ‘Special Category’ status, which entails greater funds from the central government and other significant concessions?

Arguments:
I. Yes, because they face socio-economic disadvantages due to challenging geography.
II. Yes, because they do not have a well-organized revenue collection system.

Despite their differences, there are some common features shared by both interfaces:

  • File Management: Both GUI and CLI allow users to manage files and folders on their computer system. Users can create, copy, move, delete, and rename files and folders using either interface.

  • Access to System Resources: Both interfaces provide access to the same system resources, such as the file system, hardware, and installed software.

  • Security: Both interfaces have features to manage user permissions and security settings. In GUI, users can control access to files and folders using the file manager's security features. In CLI, users can set file permissions and access rights using the command line.

  • Customization: Both interfaces offer users the ability to customize their experience. Users can modify settings and preferences, change the appearance of the interface, and configure various system settings.

  • Multitasking: Both interfaces allow users to run multiple programs and tasks simultaneously. Users can switch between different programs and tasks using either interface.

questions.question: Which of the following is the correct order of increasing capacity?

The Correct Order is kilobyte, megabyte, gigabyte, terabyte, petabyte:

  • Kilobyte (KB): A kilobyte is equal to 1,024 bytes. It is the smallest unit in this list and is typically used to measure small amounts of data. For example, a plain text file with a few paragraphs may be a few kilobytes in size.

  • Megabyte (MB): A megabyte is equal to 1,024 kilobytes or 1,048,576 bytes. It is a larger unit than a kilobyte and is commonly used to describe the size of files, documents, images, or songs. For example, a high-resolution photo might be a few megabytes in size.

  • Gigabyte (GB): A gigabyte is equal to 1,024 megabytes or 1,073,741,824 bytes. It is a unit of storage commonly used for larger files, such as videos, movies, or software applications. For example, a feature-length movie might be a few gigabytes in size.

  • Terabyte (TB): A terabyte is equal to 1,024 gigabytes or 1,099,511,627,776 bytes. It represents a substantial amount of data storage and is commonly used to measure the capacity of hard drives or data storage devices. For example, a large hard drive might have a storage capacity of a few terabytes.

  • Petabyte (PB): A petabyte is equal to 1,024 terabytes or 1,125,899,906,842,624 bytes. It is an extremely large unit of storage and is often used to describe the capacity of data centers or cloud storage systems. For example, a massive collection of videos or a vast amount of scientific research data might be measured in petabytes.

questions.question: From which date will state co-operative banks and central co-operative banks come under the ambit of the Reserve Bank Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS), 2021?
questions.explanation:

  • This expansion strengthens the grievance redressal framework for cooperative banking customers.

Key Info: 

  • The RB-IOS now covers a wide range of entities regulated by RBI, including commercial banks, RRBs, co-operative banks (state, central, and scheduled urban), certain non-scheduled urban co-op banks (with deposits ≥ ₹50 crore), NBFCs (with assets ≥ ₹100 crore) excluding HFCs, and credit information companies.
  • While most NBFCs with an asset size of ₹100 crore and above are covered under RB-IOS, housing finance companies (HFCs) are specifically excluded from the scheme.
  • Complaints against HFCs are handled under the National Housing Bank (NHB) Ombudsman Scheme.
  • The RB-IOS, launched in November 2021, aims to offer a simple, efficient, and cost-effective grievance redressal mechanism for customers of all RBI-regulated entities, replacing earlier multiple ombudsman schemes (banking, NBFCs, and digital transactions).

questions.question: Under the Reserve Bank of India (Lending Against Gold and Silver Collateral) Directions, 2025, from which date will the framework permitting silver as collateral become effective?
questions.explanation:

Key Info:

  • The RBI guidelines specify upper limits for pledging silver: up to 10 kg of silver ornaments or 500 g of silver coins. This ensures standardized loan valuation and prevents excessive risk exposure for lenders.
  • The RBI framework includes several borrower protections:
  1. Borrower presence during assessment
  2. Mandatory valuation certificate
  3. ₹5,000 penalty for delayed release
  4. Mandatory prior notification before auction
  • The framework emphasizes secure storage and handling of silver collateral only by authorized personnel. It also mandates regular audits to prevent mishandling or fraud, ensuring operational integrity.

questions.question: What is the main objective of the RBI’s deposit tokenisation pilot?
options: To launch a new cryptocurrency for retail investors
To convert bank deposits into digital tokens for improved settlement efficiency
To replace physical cash with digital wallets
questions.explanation:
• The correct answer is option 'B' that is 'To convert bank deposits into digital tokens for improved settlement efficiency'.
  • The RBI’s pilot aims to convert bank deposits into digital tokens, enabling faster, easier, and more efficient settlement across banking and financial systems.
  • It is not a retail cryptocurrency, cash replacement, privatization, or bond issuance program.

Key Info: 

  • The wholesale segment of RBI’s CBDC is being used, which is primarily intended for interbank and institutional settlements, rather than retail or cross-border use.
  • Deposit tokenisation refers to transforming traditional bank deposits into digital tokens, which can be easily transferred, settled, and used across systems, ensuring operational efficiency and regulatory compliance.
  • Beyond deposits, the RBI is exploring tokenisation of money market instruments, such as commercial papers, to enhance efficiency and transparency in the financial markets.
  • Regulatory guardrails are essential to mitigate risks, ensure legal enforceability, and maintain the integrity of tokenised deposits.
  • This ensures that the system is secure, compliant, and trustworthy for institutional and interbank settlements.

questions.question: Which organization has launched the biometric authentication system for UPI payments, replacing the existing PIN-based mechanism?

questions.question: The 2025 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded for the development of which of the following?

Yaghi (US) for their pioneering work on metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) — crystalline materials composed of metal ions linked by organic molecules, creating large porous structures that allow the flow and storage of gases and chemicals.

Key Info: 

  • The trio—Kitagawa, Robson, and Yaghi—were recognized for creating metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), which are molecular structures with large spaces that allow gases and chemicals to move freely through them.

  • Omar M. Yaghi is not affiliated with Oxford University; he is a professor at the University of California, Berkeley, USA.

  2. Richard Robson – Australia (University of Melbourne)
  3. Omar M. Yaghi – United States (University of California, Berkeley)

questions.question:
नीचे दिए गए गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और उस पर आधारित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए-

जाकिर साहब के बारे में कुछ बातें अविस्मरणीय हैं। 13 मई 1967 को राष्ट्रपति का पद संभालते हुए उन्होंने कहा था, "सारा भारत मेरा घर है, मैं सच्ची लगन से इस घर को मजबूत और सुंदर बनाने की कोशिश करूँगा ताकि वह मेरे महान देशवासियों का उपयुक्त घर हो जिसमें इंसाफ और खुशहाली का अपना स्थान हो।"

उनकी विनम्रता ऐसी थी कि उन्होंने कहा था, "मैं स्वीकार करता हूँ कि हमारी जनता ने इस उच्चतम पद के लिए निर्वाचित करके मुझ पर जो विश्वास प्रकट किया है उससे मैं बहुत प्रभावित हुआ हूँ। यह भावना इस वजह से और भी प्रबल हो जाती है कि भारत के महान सपूत डॉ. राधाकृष्णन के बाद मुझसे इस पद को संभालने के लिए कहा गया। मैं उनके कदमों पर चलने की कोशिश करूँगा, लेकिन उनकी बराबरी कैसे कर सकूँगा?"

भारत के वे असली सपूत थे, इसका सबूत उन्होंने पदारूढ़ होने के एक दिन पहले तब दिया जब वे दिल्ली में श्रृंगेरी के जगद्‌गुरु स्वामी शंकराचार्य से भेंट करने गए। जगद्‌गुरु के सामने पुष्प और फल रखते हुए उन्होने कहा था- आपका आशीर्वाद चाहिए और शंकराचार्य ने राष्ट्रपति के सिर पर हाथ रखकर उन्हें आशीर्वाद दिया था। ऐसी ही एक और घटना याद आती है। उपराष्ट्रपति निवास के अहाते में एक दिन सवेरे घूम रहे थे तो देखा कि माली के घर में कीर्तन हो रहा है। फिर क्या था, टहलते हुए उधर चले गए और सबके साथ एक कोने में दरी पर बैठ गए। जब कुर्सी लाने के लिए कहा गया तो बोले, 'भगवान के घर में सब बराबर होते हैं'- और दरी पर ही बैठे रहे। पटियाला में पंजाबी विश्वविद्यालय में गुरु गोविन्द सिंह के संस्थान की नींव रखने को आपसे कहा गया तो बोले, "आपने मुझसे इस पवित्र संस्थान की नींव रखने को कहा है। इससे मुझे याद आता है कि अमृतसर में दरबार साहब की नींव डालने के लिए भी एक मुसलमान को ही बुलाया गया था," और यह कहते-कहते उनका गला भर आया, आँखों से आँसू बहने लगे। बड़े-बड़े योद्धा सिख सरदार श्रोताओं की भी उस समय आँखें भर आईं।

एक बार रामलीला में जनता ने उनसे रामचन्द्र जी का तिलक करने के लिए कहा। जाकिर साहब खुशी से आए और तिलक किया। इस पर कुछ उर्दू अखबारों ने एतराज किया। जाकिर साहब ने जवाब दिया, "इन नादानों को मालूम नहीं है कि मैं भारत का राष्ट्रपति हूँ। किसी खास धर्म का नहीं।"

उनकी विनम्रता ऐसी थी कि उन्होंने कहा था, "मैं स्वीकार करता हूँ कि हमारी जनता ने इस उच्चतम पद के लिए निर्वाचित करके मुझ पर जो विश्वास प्रकट किया है उससे मैं बहुत प्रभावित हुआ हूँ। यह भावना इस वजह से और भी प्रबल हो जाती है कि भारत के महान सपूत डॉ. राधाकृष्णन के बाद मुझसे इस पद को संभालने के लिए कहा गया। मैं उनके कदमों पर चलने की कोशिश करूँगा, लेकिन उनकी बराबरी कैसे कर सकूँगा?"

भारत के वे असली सपूत थे, इसका सबूत उन्होंने पदारूढ़ होने के एक दिन पहले तब दिया जब वे दिल्ली में श्रृंगेरी के जगद्‌गुरु स्वामी शंकराचार्य से भेंट करने गए। जगद्‌गुरु के सामने पुष्प और फल रखते हुए उन्होने कहा था- आपका आशीर्वाद चाहिए और शंकराचार्य ने राष्ट्रपति के सिर पर हाथ रखकर उन्हें आशीर्वाद दिया था। ऐसी ही एक और घटना याद आती है। उपराष्ट्रपति निवास के अहाते में एक दिन सवेरे घूम रहे थे तो देखा कि माली के घर में कीर्तन हो रहा है। फिर क्या था, टहलते हुए उधर चले गए और सबके साथ एक कोने में दरी पर बैठ गए। जब कुर्सी लाने के लिए कहा गया तो बोले, 'भगवान के घर में सब बराबर होते हैं'- और दरी पर ही बैठे रहे। पटियाला में पंजाबी विश्वविद्यालय में गुरु गोविन्द सिंह के संस्थान की नींव रखने को आपसे कहा गया तो बोले, "आपने मुझसे इस पवित्र संस्थान की नींव रखने को कहा है। इससे मुझे याद आता है कि अमृतसर में दरबार साहब की नींव डालने के लिए भी एक मुसलमान को ही बुलाया गया था," और यह कहते-कहते उनका गला भर आया, आँखों से आँसू बहने लगे। बड़े-बड़े योद्धा सिख सरदार श्रोताओं की भी उस समय आँखें भर आईं।

एक बार रामलीला में जनता ने उनसे रामचन्द्र जी का तिलक करने के लिए कहा। जाकिर साहब खुशी से आए और तिलक किया। इस पर कुछ उर्दू अखबारों ने एतराज किया। जाकिर साहब ने जवाब दिया, "इन नादानों को मालूम नहीं है कि मैं भारत का राष्ट्रपति हूँ। किसी खास धर्म का नहीं।"

questions.question: 'मैं इस महीने के अन्त तक घर जाने वाला हूँ।' इस वाक्य में 'इस महीने के अन्त तक' क्या है?
questions.explanation:
मैं इस महीने के अन्त तक घर जाने वाला हूँ।' इस वाक्य में 'इस महीने के अन्त तक' क्या है- पदबंध।

स्पष्टीकरण-

पदबंध- जब दो या अधिक (शब्द) पद नियत क्रम और निश्चित अर्थ में किसी पद का कार्य करते हैं तो उन्हें पदबंध कहते हैं।

जैसे-

सबसे तेज दौड़ने वाला छात्र जीत गया।
यह लड़की अत्यंत सुशील और परिश्रमी है।
नदी बहती चली जा रही है।
नदी कल-कल करती हुई बह रही थी।

पहले वाक्य के ‘सबसे तेज दौड़ने वाला छात्र’ में पाँच पद है, किन्तु वे मिलकर एक ही पद अर्थात संज्ञा का कार्य कर रहे हैं। दूसरे वाक्य के ‘अत्यंत सुशील और परिश्रमी’ में भी चार पद हैं, किन्तु वे मिलकर एक ही पद अर्थात विशेषण का कार्य कर रहे हैं। तीसरे वाक्य के ‘बहती चली जा रही है’ में पाँच पद हैं किन्तु वे मिलकर एक ही पद अर्थात क्रिया का काम कर रहे हैं। चौथे वाक्य के ‘कल-कल करती हुई में तीन पद हैं, किन्तु वे मिलकर एक ही पद अर्थात क्रिया विशेषण का काम कर रहे हैं।

अतः विकल्प A सही है |

Number of females who visited Shimla = 7x – (4224 – 4.8x) = (11.8x – 4224)

Number of males who visited Mussoorie = 900

Number of females who visited Mussoorie = (5x – 900)

According to the question,

11.8x – 4224+ 5x – 900 = 2940

Or, 16.8x = 8064

Or, x = 480

Therefore, number of persons who visited Manali = (8000 – 12x) = 2240

Number of males who visited Manali = 0.4 ×2240 = 896

Number of persons who visited Shimla = 7x = 3360

Number of females who visited Shimla = 3360 – 1920 = 1440

Number of persons who visited Mussoorie = 5x = 2400

questions.question: Two pipes J and K can fill a tank in 20 hours and 30 hours respectively. If both the pipes are opened simultaneously, find after how much time should pipe K be closed so that the tank is full in 18 hours?
questions.explanation:
Let the capacity of the tank be LCM (20, 30) = 60 units
Efficiency of pipe J = 6020 = 3 units/hour
Efficiency of pipe K = 6030 = 2 units/hour
The combined efficiency of pipes J and K = 5 units/hour
Let both J and K be opened for ‘n’ hours and then, K be closed and only J be opened for the remaining

’18 – n’ hours.
5n + 3 × (18 – n) = 60
2n + 54 = 60
2n = 6
n = 3 hours

Alternate Method:

Pipe J fills tank in 20 hours
Pipe K fills tank in 30 hours
Both opened together,
The tank must be completely filled in 18 hours
We need to find after how many hours K should be closed.
Take LCM of 20 and 30 = 60 units (total tank capacity = 60 units)
Work done per hour 
J = 60 ÷ 20 = 3 units/hour
K = 60 ÷ 30 = 2 units/hour
Let pipe K be open for x hours.
So, J will be open for 18 hours (full duration).
Total work =
(J’s 18 hours work) + (K’s x hours work) = 60 units
3×18 + 2×x = 60
54 + 2x = 60
2x = 6
x = 3 hours
Pipe K should be closed after 3 hours so that the tank is full in 18 hours.

questions.question: 'A' and 'B' start running together from point 'X' towards point 'Y'. At the same time, 'C' leaves from point 'Y' towards point 'X'. 'C' meets 'A' and 'B' at points 'M' and 'N' respectively, which are 150 metre and 75 metres away from point 'X'. Find the ratio of speed of 'A' to 'B', given that 'X' and 'Y' are 225 metres apart.

Therefore, NM = 150 - 75 = 75 metres

Therefore, XN = XM = 75 metres

Also, YM = 225 - 75 - 75 = 75 metres

Distance covered by 'A' by the time he meets 'C' = 150 metres

Distance covered by 'C' during the same duration = 75 metres

Since time taken by 'A' and 'C' is same, the ratio of speeds of 'A' and 'C' will be same as the ratio of distance covered by them.

So, ratio of speeds of 'A' and 'C' = 150:75 = 2:1

Similarly, distance covered by 'B' by the time he meets 'C' = 75 metres

Distance covered by 'C' during the same duration = 150 metres

So, ratio of speeds of 'B' and 'C' = 75:150 = 1:2

So, speed of 'C' = (2x/2) = x m/s

And speed of 'B' = (x/2) = (x/2) m/s

So, required ratio = 2x:(x/2) = 4:1

Hence, option a.

questions.question: A box contains 4 magenta coloured, 2 orange coloured and 3 fluorescent coloured balls. One ball is drawn randomly. What is the probability that the ball drawn is magenta ?
questions.explanation:
Given,

Total number of balls = 4 + 2 + 3 = 9

So, to choose 1 ball from 9 balls = \(\ _{}^{9}C_{1}\) = \(\frac{9!}{1!\ (9 - 1)!}\)

= \(\frac{9 \times 8!}{8!}\) = 9

= Total number of outcomes

And the total number of magenta balls = 4

So, So, to choose 1 ball from 4 balls = \(\ _{}^{4}C_{1}\) = \(\frac{4!}{1!\ (4 - 1)!}\)

= \(\frac{4 \times 3!}{3!}\) = 4

= total number of favorable outcomes

Probability = Total number of favorable outcomes / Total number of outcomes

So, the probability that the ball drawn is magenta = \(\frac{4}{9}\)

y = 25%
